identity: ONE original lithe adult boarder, the Wakechain Boarder, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the deep white hood shading the face, the long tattered cream coat lined with dark blue and the loose blue cloth streamers, the dark leather armour with crossed belts and a small glowing amber lantern at the waist, the dark gloves and boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Each hand holds ONE curved steel hook on a dark iron chain, the chains looped loosely around the arms, two chain-hooks in all. Preserve the hood, both chain-hooks, the coat and the lithe proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full hood, both chains with their hooks even at full swing, the coat, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, sparks, swirl trails, particles or extra limbs; the lantern keeps only its steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; each chain stays one unbroken line attached to its hook.

idle_h3_v1.action: A restless, ready idle that loops. The boarder breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, both hooks sway a little on their chains, the hooded head turns slightly to watch and the coat and streamers stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Stride in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with quick light steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel, the hooks swinging on their chains and the coat tails trailing. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE chain-hook throw toward screen right. The boarder whirls one hook overhead on its chain as the knees bend, then steps into a long lunge and flings it straight out so the chain pulls taut and the hook reaches full length at screen right, yanks it back and settles into the original stance. One throw only; the hook stays on its chain and no swirl or effect appears.

hit_h3_v1.action: The boarder starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The hooded head and shoulders hunch and twist away and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the chains, then the boarder straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Cross both hooks in front of the hood with the chains pulled taut between the hands as a guard, bend the knees into a low stance, then hold the crossed guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A boarding signal. The boarder raises one hook high overhead on its chain and holds it up as a signal to the crew, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly from standing. The boarder doubles over and sinks onto both knees with the chains dropping, stays kneeling a moment, then slumps forward and lies flat on the ground, finishing motionless with the hood at screen right, the coat spread out and both chain-hooks lying beside the body. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
